summary: Burnt Peak lookout, Gifford Pinchot NF, Skamania County WA: L-4 cab built 1931 or 1932 (sources differ), lookouts named to 1963, removed; WillhiteWeb summit captions mention a foundation and benches.

facts.status_note: FFLOS says the cab has been removed, with no date; firelookout.com says it is not clear when it was destroyed. WillhiteWeb summit photo captions, which carry no dates, mention a square foundation (one says still rising) and two benches just below the site.

staffing.status: lookouts named in 1938 (Jack Price) and 1963 (Louie Larson); a USGS party reported the lookout abandoned in 1964

access.note: Gifford Pinchot National Forest; WillhiteWeb describes forest roads FR 3211 and FR 704 to a road high point, then a short off-trail climb. No source gives current road or closure status.

visit.trail_note: Park at the road high point on the north side of the mountain; WillhiteWeb lists half a mile off trail and about 400 feet of gain

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not settled. WillhiteWeb and Rex's give 1931 for the lookout station; the FFLOS register and firelookout.com give 1932 for the cab. The story reports both.

The register says the cab has been removed, with no date; firelookout.com says it is unclear when it was destroyed. WillhiteWeb's last report is the 1964 abandonment note. No removal date is supported.

notes_for_editor: Thin sources: the only description of what remains is in WillhiteWeb summit photo captions, which carry no dates, and the 2000 FFLOS eyebolt photo is the only dated item about the site. Do not confuse with other Burnt Peak lookouts that appeared in search results (an Oregon site at firetower.org/lookouts/us/or/burnt-peak-lookout-site/ and a Montana site at firelookout.com/mt/burntpeak.html); they were not used. Access route date is unknown. Rex's 'Removed' label on its page has no date. No photos added.
